manufacturer.name: Meccanica Fadini
manufacturer.note: Italian gate, barrier and bollard automation manufacturer. fadini.net is named as the manufacturer's site in the documents themselves, but no fadini.net documentation URL was surfaced, so supportUrl is null and every document here is a reseller or aggregator copy. The Nyota drive was searched for and returned nothing; no record is made for it.

Neither the document nor the page has been opened, so its presence at this URL, its edition and its contents are all unconfirmed. Treat as a lead, not a citation, until manuals:verify has run against it. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Elpro 980 Instructions (GB)
documents.evidence: Reseller copy. The file name's istr_ prefix and _gb suffix match Fadini's own document naming, which is why the GB edition is recorded, but the file sits on a reseller domain. Filed under accessories because the Elpro 980 is the control unit that pairs with the Bayt 980 barrier, not a drive in its own right. Not fetched - egress blocked.
